title: Software Engineer - Backend Developer
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

Design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of software solutions that support business and customer outcomes. This role applies coding skills to defined capabilities with limited guidance, builds an understanding of system architecture and upstream/downstream dependencies, and supports quality, reliability, security, and maintainability in every deliverable.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, debug, test, deploy, and maintain assigned software capabilities, features, APIs, services, scripts, or application components
* Write clean, secure, reusable, and maintainable code that aligns with team standards, engineering practices, and quality expectations
* Apply an automation\-first mindset by improving repeatable development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and support tasks
* Participate in Agile delivery activities including backlog refinement, estimation, sprint planning, demos, reviews, and retrospectives
* Collaborate with product owners, business partners, quality engineers, architects, and peer engineers to translate requirements into working solutions
* Develop an understanding of application architecture, cost/complexity tradeoffs, and dependencies across upstream and downstream systems
* Instrument delivered features using standard logging, monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic practices so issues can be detected and resolved early
* Support production readiness by contributing to CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, deployment validation, incident analysis, and post\-release improvements
* Troubleshoot defects, performance bottlenecks, data issues, and operational problems; recommend corrective actions with guidance from senior engineers
* Continuously learn modern engineering practices, cloud, DevOps, security, AI\-enabled development methods, and emerging tools relevant to the team's technology stack
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* Typically 2\+ years of relevant professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability
* Hands\-on experience with at least one modern programming language such as Java, Python, C\#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar
* Experience developing or supporting web applications, APIs, backend services, batch jobs, cloud\-native services, or enterprise application components
* Working knowledge of software development fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, debugging, unit testing, and version control
* Awareness of CI/CD practices, automated testing, code quality tools, observability, secure coding, and production support expectations
* Ability to analyze problems, learn unfamiliar systems, communicate clearly, and deliver assigned work with quality and accountability

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP
* Experience with monitoring or diagnostics tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, or similar
* Exposure to microservices, REST APIs, event\-driven architecture, containers, Kubernetes/OpenShift, or platform engineering concepts
* Working knowledge of relational or NoSQL databases and basic data modeling principles
* Exposure to healthcare, claims, compliance, security, or regulated enterprise environments
* Proven interest in using AI\-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve design, coding, testing, documentation, and delivery productivity

 **Core Competencies:**

* Engineering Execution: Delivers assigned features with quality, maintainability, and attention to technical standards
* Problem Solving: Uses data, logs, debugging techniques, and structured analysis to resolve issues and improve solutions
* Quality Mindset: Builds quality into code through reviews, testing, automation, and attention to reliability and security
* Collaboration: Works effectively with cross\-functional partners and communicates progress, risks, and dependencies clearly
* Learning Agility: Stays current with modern engineering practices, tools, and emerging technologies relevant to the role
* Customer Focus: Understands customer and business outcomes and contributes to solutions that improve user experience and operational effectiveness

 **Work Model and Expectations**


This role operates in a collaborative Agile environment and may require participation in production support, release validations, incident response, and cross\-time\-zone coordination based on business needs The engineer is expected to follow enterprise standards for security, compliance, documentation, code quality, and operational readinesse required to pass a drug test before beginning employment

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Backend Developer
description:
**Backend Developer / Data Engineer**

**Location:** Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-site  
**Contract:** Full\-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy supporting businesses operating across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

Our work spans regulatory compliance, product safety, responsible person services, market access, product stewardship, brand protection and technology\-enabled compliance solutions across international markets including the UK, USA, India, Europe, GCC/UAE and other global markets.

As our technology and digital capabilities continue to grow, we are looking for a **Backend Developer / Data Engineer** to join our India\-based technology team and help develop reliable systems, data infrastructure and backend services that support our internal operations and technology platforms.

**The Role**

You will be responsible for developing, maintaining and improving backend applications, APIs, databases and data pipelines used across GCRS technology platforms and internal systems.

The role combines **backend software development and data engineering**, making it suitable for someone who enjoys building robust systems while also working with structured data, integrations, automation and reporting.

You will work closely with developers, product stakeholders and business teams to understand requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

This is a hands\-on role in a growing environment where you will have the opportunity to contribute to architecture, development standards, automation and the improvement of our overall technology infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain backend applications and services
* Develop secure and reliable APIs and integrations
* Build and maintain databases and data models
* Develop data pipelines for collecting, transforming and processing information
* Integrate internal systems and third\-party services through APIs
* Write clean, maintainable and well\-documented code
* Optimise backend performance, database queries and system reliability
* Develop automated processes for data handling and operational workflows
* Support the development of reporting and analytics infrastructure
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency and integrity
* Identify and resolve backend and data\-related issues
* Conduct testing, debugging and performance improvements
* Work with frontend developers to support application functionality
* Collaborate with AI and technology teams where backend or data infrastructure is required
* Maintain appropriate technical documentation
* Support deployment and ongoing maintenance of applications
* Monitor systems and investigate technical issues
* Follow appropriate security and data\-protection practices
* Contribute to technical architecture and development standards
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve automation and efficiency

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is technically strong, analytical and comfortable working across backend development and data.

You should enjoy solving problems, understanding how systems work and building reliable solutions rather than simply completing individual coding tasks.

You will need to be comfortable working independently while also collaborating closely with other technology and business teams.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Experience in backend development, software engineering or data engineering
* Strong knowledge of at least one backend programming language such as Python, Java, Node.js or similar
* Strong understanding of databases and SQL
* Experience developing APIs and system integrations
* Understanding of data structures and data modelling
* Experience working with relational databases
* Understanding of data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
* Good understanding of software development principles
* Experience with Git and version control
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Understanding of application security and data protection
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to document technical work clearly
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

**Desirable Experience**

* Python\-based data engineering and development of data processing pipelines.
* PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar relational database technologies.
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Docker for application containerization and deployment.
* Data warehouses, business intelligence systems or analytics platforms.
* Automation and workflow tools used for streamlining data and operational processes.
* AI/ML systems and their integration with data engineering workflows.
* Handling large, complex or high\-volume datasets.
* SaaS, consultancy, technology or professional services environments.

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within your first six months, you will have:

* Developed and maintained reliable backend services
* Improved the performance and stability of existing systems
* Established effective data pipelines and database structures
* Delivered APIs and integrations required by the business
* Improved data quality and accessibility
* Reduced manual data\-processing requirements
* Worked effectively with frontend, AI and business teams
* Contributed to better technical documentation and development standards
* Helped create a stronger and more scalable technology foundation for GCRS

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to join a growing international business where technology is increasingly important to how we operate and deliver services.

You will have the opportunity to work on meaningful internal and client\-facing technology projects and contribute directly to the development of systems that support an international regulatory business.

**Important:** This is a **fully on\-site role based at the GCRS office in Hapur, Uttar Pradesh**. Candidates must be willing to **work from the Hapur office five days a week**.

Work Location: In person
